scope: Remove singular NGE profession and combat-level presentation from GCW rows, instance logs, LFG, groups, guild membership, and city citizenship without changing retained content admission.

eraEvidence.publish141Boundary: Publish 14.1 characters own multiple independently learned skill professions and have no singular roadmap class or combat level.
eraEvidence.gcwBoundary: The profession and level fields are presentation values; GCW score accumulation uses separate counters.
eraEvidence.instanceBoundary: The class and level values are used only in CustomerServiceLog strings after the player has already been admitted and transferred.
eraEvidence.nativeSocialBoundary: LFG, group, guild, and city transports inherited a singular roadmap profession plus combat-level field even though Publish 14.1 characters own multiple independent profession skill graphs.
eraEvidence.nativePersistenceBoundary: Guild and city records can preserve old profession-template and combat-level values until rewritten, so online synchronization and all new writes must normalize both fields.
